combo_label: At the Vet's × Caves & Caving × The Canterbury Tales

entries.clue: ___ Hole: Somerset show cave on the River Axe, with a legendary witch
Tall narrow passage opened along a crack in the rock
Coat of hair parted by hand to check the skin beneath for tiny black specks
Precious yellow metal; eight bushels of it under a tree undo the three who find it
Preaching from the pulpit on one text: greed is the root of all evil
Where horseshoe bats hang to hibernate, protected by law from disturbance
Holy tomb that draws the faithful; theirs stood behind the high altar
Harry Bailly, master of the lodging, who rides along and will judge the telling
Theatre job on the morning list, with nothing to eat beforehand
Qualified professional on the register, whose job title begins 'veterinary'
Ultrasound look at what is going on inside a poorly tummy, with cold gel
Pig's bones in glass and a pillowcase called Our Lady's veil, sold as holy
Scoop cut in a cave wall by water, its steeper side facing upstream
